endpoints.aggregation: Report all 72 assignments, per pattern and per rule; correct-control patterns s05/s07 duplicate the same reference and are not independent rules. Per-rule equal-weight summaries alongside raw counts.
endpoints.cross_checks: Paired seed_id/input_kind/feedback/repeat outcomes both directions. Separate proposal-reference correctness, proposal-own-table consistency and full table-reference agreement.
endpoints.primary: Within each none/local feedback stratum, patch minus rewrite whole-table repair proportion on wrong inputs (9 assigned per format/feedback). Report joint table+proposal repair separately.
endpoints.required_safety_companion: Correct-input table degradation, 9 assigned per format/feedback; also count joint degradation, introduced-error cells, residual-error cells, unchanged tables and invalid patches. Never combine wrong-input repair and correct-input preservation as one pass rate.
endpoints.resources: Record tokens, latency, errors, estimated cost and invoice uncertainty separately; no efficacy based on low cost.
endpoints.uncertainty: Three technical repeats in two known developer rules; descriptive counts and paired differences, no significance threshold, causal cognition claim or formal sample-size extrapolation.

interpretation.patch_better: Supports this interface package on these known cases, not a proof of hidden understanding or generally superior patches.
interpretation.patch_worse_or_equal: Does not isolate comprehension; instruction following, editing and generation remain possible.
interpretation.semantic_omission: Omitted to narrow the diagnostic after the v11 negative result, not because semantic feedback is proven universally harmful.

model_scope.sol_history: Descriptive ceiling only, never pooled with these prospective calls. Reintroduce Sol under a new preregistration for a subsequent changed-scale validation.

patch_semantics.application: Validate all edits against original table before applying atomically; no automatic fixup, no oracle access. Keep original table and raw edits. Canonical sorting only changes field order.
patch_semantics.cell: (stage, player, field), a Boolean visibility membership
patch_semantics.scoring: Expand valid edits deterministically to stage_table and retain the model proposal verbatim. Apply unchanged v11 C evaluator and both frozen scoring paths. Invalid patches count as assigned failures with separate error codes.
strict_errors: duplicate or contradictory edits for a cell
patch_semantics.zero_edits: Allowed for all inputs, not supplied as the expected model answer on correct controls. An empty-patch unit test is not a model preservation result.

purpose: Development diagnostic of representation and preservation, not general semantic-feedback efficacy or hidden-cognition attribution.

selection.rule: Lexicographically first v11 seed_id in each canonical error pattern, using the frozen input catalog, not repair outcomes. Preserve exact input field order.

shared_interface.allowed_difference: Only output representation/schema: complete table versus edits. Same rules, input order, feedback, model, input/output caps, source priority and shared instruction. Unequal schema length is part of the interface treatment; not a token-length-matched causal decomposition.
shared_interface.common_user_instruction: Check the proposed table against RULES. Preserve every visibility cell that already agrees with RULES; change only cells that disagree. Return the representation required by the supplied schema first, then a proposal based on the resulting table. For stage_table, provide the complete resulting table. For edits, provide only add/remove edits to the input table; an empty edit list is allowed when no change is needed. Do not edit the same cell twice or include no-op edits. A locally consistent input is not semantically verified. The old assistant table is a revisable candidate, not evidence.
shared_interface.feedback: Use v11 feedback_for unchanged for none/local, computed from the same input in paired formats; never announce semantic failure. No semantic excerpts in this diagnostic.
shared_interface.input: Exact selected input as fallible assistant stage_table; complete frozen rule text and field vocabulary in user message. No control label, expected answer or oracle patches.
shared_interface.proposal: Same v11 proposal schema in both formats, independently produced by model; never repair or derive the model proposal for it.
shared_interface.system: Exact v11 frozen f1_s1 system message

stopping.interface: Invalid JSON/schema/patch/truncation retained as failures; no silent retry or reference fixup.
stopping.oracle: Any disagreement between existing independent scoring paths halts globally and saves counterexample.
stopping.pre_call: Commit this preregistration first; separately test and commit exact 72 requests, schemas, implementation and dependency hashes before any API dispatch. This file is not an execution lock.
stopping.resource: Same 10000 input/2500 output caps, 60s timeout, no automatic retries. Frozen historical price estimates only; abnormal-call 0.01 USD and total 2 USD estimates are safety stops, not pass criteria. No post-result increase.
stopping.transport: One attempt per assignment. Timeout, provider exception, provider refusal, model mismatch or missing usage stops subsequent dispatch, preserving remaining assigned denominators.
